description: ArtCraft is an intentional crafting engine for artists, designers, and filmmakers
vibe: Readable code is a form of respect—for the next human and the next agent.
highlights: Compile-time checked SQLx macros preferred over runtime queries
Strict file layout optimized for top-to-bottom reading, with private helpers below callers
No println!/eprintln! outside tests; use log crate macros
Markdown tables must be space-padded so columns align in plain text
Repository pruning must preserve untracked and ignored local files
assessment: This file treats code as a communication artifact, not just an executable one. The insistence on top-to-bottom reading order, compile-time SQL verification, and even space-padded Markdown tables shows a rare consistency of taste across languages and formats. It is effective because it reduces cognitive load for both humans and agents while preventing common slop patterns like runtime SQL errors and unreadable diffs.
